name: Dr. Injouji
source:
A female mad scientist in an evil organization. She has a nice body and recruits Masayoshi to the evil organization at a bar.

She creates a new kinds of monsters by combining various living creatures. She has the technology to perfectly regenerate and restore cells to never age. No one knows how old she is.

[Translation from [url=http://amatures.ohimesama.net/sentou/]Official Site[/url]]
